Goyal2022.title: A biomimetic skin phantom for characterizing wearable electrodes in the low-frequency regime
Goyal2022.independent_read_scope: Primary full HTML methods/results/captions; PDF page numbering not independently verified in this environment
Goyal2022.upper_layer: SC surrogate: PDMS with carbon black and barium titanate; composition/porosity dependent, not undoped PDMS
Goyal2022.lower_layer: PVA-c equivalent of remaining epidermis+dermis+hypodermis; not an independent dermis layer
Goyal2022.temperature_caution: 22C is reported thaw/storage condition, not established measurement temperature
rejected_inferences: Whole electrode+phantom Z is not unique layer bulk sigma/epsilon
1MOhm/10nF targets and undoped-PDMS epsilon cannot specify the mixed SC bulk
3k/3030/9k/9090 and historical2k/2010 exceed the tested1-1000Hz band

Anand2019.title: Tissue phantoms to mimic the dielectric properties of human forearm section for multi-frequency bioimpedance analysis at low frequencies
Anand2019.independent_read_scope: Primary publisher text cache/methods and PubMed;2019PDF/curve assets HTTP403; exact curve values not independently digitized

individual_material_measurement.instrument: Keysight E4980A with coaxial immersion-depth method
individual_material_measurement.temperature: room temperature; exact C not reported

whole_forearm_measurement.fit: Cole extrapolation to2MHz; not an individual fat/muscle material fit

Anand2019.fat_recipe_context: 5percent agar plus0.05percent saline; final mass-fraction inference is not a reported exact table
Anand2019.target_vs_measurement: Fabricated phantom curves differ from Gabriel tissue target curves; neither is a measurement of this project phantom

author_2017_thesis_context.limitations: Fat plot datasets/ranges differ within thesis; some permittivity frequency-axis labels are ambiguous. Do not silently reinterpret units or substitute as2019 carrier calibration.

NGG_PBS_EIS_scope: Electrode interface specific impedance, not layer bulk sigma/epsilon and not validated dry skin contact
missing_data_priority: Independent SC and dermis bulk complex spectra/validated fits with geometry and interface de-embedding
Material-specific50frequency tables or calibratedR/C+conversion/fit coefficients for2019 fat/muscle
FEM/FVM spatial convergence and independent interface tests; separate from material calibration
